editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a foreign airport with gunmen surrounding you, knowing the whole world is watching. You get to experience this tension right away as you follow the hostages and the Israeli commandos planning a daring rescue. The vibe is like a high-stakes puzzle where the leaders have to guess exactly how the airport is laid out before they fly in. It feels less like a polished Hollywood blockbuster and more like a gritty, real-time news report that keeps you on the edge of your seat wondering if the plan will actually work.

What really works here is how the movie builds the stress. The acting is solid and makes you care about the people trapped in the terminal. While some of the special effects look a bit old now, the pacing is fast and never feels boring. If you love true stories about bravery, you will really enjoy this one.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the Israeli soldiers landing their planes in the middle of the night. They storm the airport, take out the guards, and break into the terminal to save the hostages. There is a big shootout, but the commandos move fast and get the people out safely. They fly everyone back home just as the sun rises, proving that the risky plan actually worked and leaving the Ugandan army defeated.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories and military rescue missions.
